evidence: zircon_plugins/net/features/rpc/runtime/src/manager/dispatch.rs:191-219 方向与session门禁判定对象不一致；zircon_runtime/src/core/framework/net/rpc.rs:23-32 Bidirectional允许有效实际方向；zircon_plugins/net/features/rpc/runtime/src/tests/dispatch.rs:92-119 真实双向测试位置
impact_or_question: Bidirectional descriptor允许客户端的ClientToServer invocation，但Joined/source_session检查只在descriptor为ClientToServer时执行。因此无source invocation可通过方向检查继续进入schema/配额/handler。实际双向测试只覆盖已Joined客户端与合法服务器。
next_action: 用实际 invocation direction 和 caller 统一校验客户端 session，覆盖 missing/unknown/prejoin/closed 双向调用。

evidence: zircon_plugins/net/features/rpc/runtime/src/manager/registry.rs:17-27 任意Fn注册边界；zircon_plugins/net/features/rpc/runtime/src/manager/dispatch.rs:23-29 dispatch持锁；zircon_plugins/net/features/rpc/runtime/src/manager/dispatch.rs:42-52 invoke持锁；zircon_plugins/net/features/rpc/runtime/src/manager/dispatch.rs:67-81 enqueue持锁；zircon_plugins/net/features/rpc/runtime/src/manager/dispatch.rs:229-237 直接执行回调；zircon_plugins/net/features/rpc/runtime/src/manager/dispatch.rs:14-20 重入查询取同锁；zircon_plugins/net/features/rpc/runtime/src/manager/registry.rs:42-48 descriptor查询也取同锁
impact_or_question: 注册validator可以捕获同一个manager clone。dispatch/invoke/enqueue在持有state Mutex时直接调用validator；validator若调用pending_request/rpc_descriptor会再次等待同一非重入Mutex，无法完成。
next_action: 复制 validator 在锁外执行，再验证注册版本/session；覆盖合法 callback 重入和替换竞态。
